title: Consolidate Tra cứu single search hub with inline Saved tab and list-page redirects

spec.problem: Reference discovery is fragmented across /search, /dictionary, /kanji, /grammar, /saved, and /search/history, forcing learners to jump between separate pages and exposing duplicate redirecting list routes in sitemap.xml.

acceptance.text: 1. /{locale}/search adds a localized Saved tab pill ('Đã lưu'/'Saved'/'保存済み') alongside All/Vocabulary/Kanji/Grammar/Examples/BJT lessons that renders SavedPageClient inline (embedded mode, no nested main/h1, same bookmarks APIs, URL synced via ?tab=saved) and reads both ?scope= and ?kind= filter params on mount. 2. List pages server-redirect under Strategy (a) (keeping client components on disk): /{locale}/dictionary -> /{locale}/search?scope=lexeme, /{locale}/kanji -> /{locale}/search?scope=kanji, /{locale}/grammar -> /{locale}/search?scope=grammar, /{locale}/saved -> /{locale}/search?tab=saved, /{locale}/search/history -> /{locale}/search. 3. Detail pages (/dictionary/[id], /kanji/[id], /grammar/[id]) and /exercises remain untouched and render directly; detail page Back links and SearchDetailPanel saved-list link point directly to /{locale}/search?... without redirect hops. 4. app/sitemap.ts removes redirecting list routes (dictionary, kanji, grammar, saved, search/history) and indexes search; app/sitemap.test.ts updated per Policy §5 because the canonical public route list intentionally changed from 14 to 12 routes when dictionary/kanji/grammar became server redirects into /search.

classification.rationale: Web-only Next.js App Router UI consolidation, i18n, server redirects, and sitemap update across /search, /saved, /dictionary, /kanji, /grammar, and /search/history with zero backend, database, auth, or shared-package changes.
